steps.say: A number pattern goes up or down by the same jump.

figure.alt: Stones in a row: 12, 14, 16, 18, a blank stone.

steps.say: Find the jump by comparing two numbers next to each other.
Add the jump to the last number to keep going.
Adding 10 changes the tens digit. The ones stay the same.

figure.alt: Stones in a row: 35, 40, 45, a blank stone.

hints: How much do the numbers go up each time?
Which digit changes when you take away 10?
The tens digit goes down by 1. The ones stay the same.
72 has 7 tens. Take away one ten.
check.explanation: 72 has 7 tens. One less ten makes 62.
